headline: Young Harris, Lees-McRae and Ferrum remain unbeaten
dek: Young Harris have drawn both of their matches outside the conference and won both inside it, at home to Southern Wesleyan and then at Erskine. Their four goals conceded in four matches is bettered only by Lees-McRae and Ferrum.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Southern Wesleyan have scored more goals than any other programme, from seven different scorers, and have still lost three of their five matches.

wire.line: King are the only side without a point, four defeats from four.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Sixteen matches dated before today carry no result at all, the earliest Converse's home match against Spartanburg Methodist on Aug 13 and the latest Mount Olive's visit to Virginia State on Sep 4.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: North Greenville's first win came at Belmont Abbey on Sep 8, after three defeats in which they had scored every time.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Enzo Joly, a freshman, has three of Emmanuel's eight goals, from ten shots.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Lucas Kibrya has made 29 saves for Chowan and been beaten seven times, in a side that has yet to win.

last_match.line: Francis Marion have won away at Chowan and now at Wingate inside a week, after losing at home to AUM.

next_match.line: Young Harris have won both of their conference matches; King have lost every match they have played.
